mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (2017=100 index) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 218.0 signals accelerating price pressures that prompt imminent Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 218.0, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.5%), consumer spending weakness reduces corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 600.0 indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without threshold dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 101.0 signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate capital expenditure, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 101.0, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.
